description: Maps TeknoParrot <JoystickButtons><ButtonName> entries to WheelMap logical controls. Per-game 'map' entries win over 'rules'. A value of null means 'leave this binding untouched'. 'A|B' means: use A if the device profile has it, else B. Rules are case-insensitive .NET regexes on ButtonName, optionally restricted by AnalogType. Input names were read from E:\DRIVE Collection\emulators\TeknoParrot\GameProfiles\<id>.xml (v1.0.0.1919), not guessed; run dev\Build-TeknoParrotTemplate.ps1 to re-check against a newer TeknoParrot.

rules.why: keyboard-for-axis helpers, hidden when an analog wheel is bound
reverse half of a flight throttle; only needed for keyboard/2-button throttles
BattleGear4: H-shifter gear that doubles as sequential shift

ArcticThunder.notes: Handlebar game: wheel works, no brake input. Attack = Action1.

Ballistics.notes: Throttle is the gas pedal (AnalogType Gas). Flip/Cooler on Action1/2.

Batman.notes: Start is P1Button2 and Fire is P1ButtonStart in this profile - mapping is by name so it lands correctly. Brake is a button input: pedal axis is bound as digital.

BattleGear4Tuned.notes: Real 6-speed H-shifter + clutch game (Wheel=Analog20, Gas=Analog6, Brake=Analog8, Clutch=Analog12). Without an H-shifter the "Gear 3/4 / Shift Up/Down" entries fall back to the paddles (v1919 and v894 name them the other way round; the rules handle both). v894 also has Shift Left/Right.

BlazingAngels.notes: Primary fire shares the Start input. Throttle is SWThrottle (single axis).

Cars.notes: Boost shares the Start input. Brake is a button input (pedal bound as digital).

ChaseHQ2.notes: Hi/Lo gear: 'Shift Low' on the left paddle. Two nitro buttons: Shift-Nitro on Nitro, Pato-Nitro on Action1. Wheel/Gas/Brake use Analog4/6/8.

CrazyRide.notes: Test doubles as test-menu up, Service as test-menu down.

D1GP.notes: Analog handbrake recommended: bind Side Brake to the handbrake device if present. Save card input left untouched.

Daytona3.notes: Daytona USA Championship: 4-speed H (Gear 1-4) or sequential paddles; 4 VR view buttons.

Daytona3Single.notes: Only in D:\Emulators\TeknoParrot (v894) UserProfiles; no GameProfile in either install - generated from the existing UserProfile.

DeadHeatRiders.notes: Brake is a button input (P1Button3): pedal bound as digital.

DirtyDrivin.notes: Test/Service are P1Button3/4 in this profile. 'Crank The Yank!' lever -> handbrake if analog/button handbrake captured, else Action1.

FNFSB.notes: Brake axis doubles as shift down.

FNFSC.notes: Gear Shift 1-4 are JVS player-2 inputs.

FR.notes: Ford Racing Full Blown: paddles + view only.

GaelcoChampionshipTuningRace.notes: Shift buttons double as menu up/down.

GRID.notes: Gear 1-6 + reverse optional. Reset on Action2.

H2Overdrive.notes: Test/Service on P1Button3/4. 'Service / Coin' is the credit input -> Coin.

ID4Exp.notes: Initial D: sequential paddles or H-shifter (Gear 1-6). View Change = Cross.

ID6.notes: RealGearshift config field = 1 for an H-shifter. FFB Blaster category in profile.

IDTA.notes: Wheel/Gas/Brake are Analog1/3/5. Test/Service/Start are P1Button5/2/3.

MKDX.notes: Item = Action1, Mario button = Action2. Banapass card input untouched.

NitroplusBlasterz.notes: Present in the racing UserProfiles folder but is a fighter: only Test/Service/Coin/Start/menu directions are mapped.

or2spdlx.notes: OutRun 2 SP DX: Hi/Lo via paddles.

R-Tuned.notes: Two boost buttons both on Nitro.

segartv.notes: Sega Race TV: Boost on Nitro.

SnoCross.notes: Credits button is the coin input.

SRC.notes: Sega Racing Classic (Daytona 2): 4 coloured VR buttons, 4-speed H or paddles.

SRG.notes: Storm Racer G. Debug Menu untouched.

StarWars.notes: Star Wars Battle Pod: Analog X/Y = yoke, Throttle = SWThrottle.

abc.notes: After Burner Climax: stick X/Y, throttle lever, gun/missile/climax.

UDX.notes: Under Defeat HD+: digital stick -> hat, Button1 Fire, Button2 Missile(bomb), Button3 Special. Player 2 untouched.

SWDC.notes: Wheel/Gas/Brake are Analog1/3/5. Shift Up is P2ButtonStart. Coloured buttons untouched.

WastelandRacers.notes: Gear = hi/lo toggle on the right paddle. Cheat inputs untouched.

WMMT5.notes: Gear Shift 1-6 for H-shifter; Up/Down for paddles. Perspective switch = view.
